original_question:
Design a Verilog module named `four_to_one`.
The module should have the following interface:
Inputs: `input1`, `input2`, `input3`, `input4` (all 1-bit wide)
Output: `output1` (1-bit wide)

Implement the combinational logic such that the output `output1` is high (`1'b1`) whenever one or more of the inputs (`input1`, `input2`, `input3`, `input4`) are high (`1'b1`). The output should be low (`1'b0`) only when all inputs are low (`1'b0`).
